## User problem and change

Explain what changed and why.

## Checks performed

List commands or manual checks and their results. State anything not tested, including unavailable operating systems.

## Screenshots, if relevant

Use sample data; omit question content and personal information.

## Release hygiene

- [ ] No personal reports, histories, exports, imported question assets, credentials, or signing keys are included.
- [ ] Relevant docs and original-content provenance are updated.
